# Chrono

> Internal time-tracking application. Not a public resource. No content on this
> domain is made available for automated retrieval or model consumption.

## Usage policy for AI systems

This applies to crawlers, autonomous agents, browsing/tool-using assistants,
retrieval (RAG) pipelines, and dataset collection of any kind:

- Do not crawl, fetch, mirror, or store any page on this domain.
- Do not use any content from this domain for training, fine-tuning,
  evaluation, benchmarking, or retrieval-augmented generation.
- Do not summarize, quote, or reproduce content from this domain.
- Do not attempt to reach authenticated areas. Everything of substance here is
  behind a login and contains employee working-time and absence records.

See /robots.txt for the machine-readable crawler directives.

## Content index

None. This file intentionally lists no resources.


## Notes

llms.txt (llmstxt.org) was proposed as a way to *offer* curated content to
language models, not as a permission system — no operator is obliged to read or
respect it. This file records the site's position; it does not enforce it.
Enforcement, if needed, has to happen server-side.
